data.title: Judge Rejects Gemini, CFTC Bid To Overturn $5M Settlement In Bitcoin Futures Case
data.description: The CFTC sued Gemini in 2022, and the exchange agreed to pay the $5 million penalty in January 2025 after more than three years of litigation.
